ruling: Fresh native CLI sessions each label their local collaboration tree /root; this alias is relative to the separate session and does not identify the same Controller. Independence is checked using actual distinct native thread UUID and absence of design/implementation/test-authorship/RCA participation, not a repeated local alias. The preliminary BLOCKED report is preserved and is not used as approval; F1 is sent to the original implementer for reproduction/fix and a new fresh reviewer will assess final C.
